Makes the two self-hosted-pinned trunk basic checks callable from repositories outside the celestia-island org.

Both reusable workflows hardcode `runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, local]`. Org runners are org-scoped: a caller repo outside the org (first consumer: langyo/0721, adopted into the family tooling this week) queues those jobs forever — observed as two runs stuck 8+ minutes with no eligible runner, while the two configurable/hosted checks (depspec-lint, ci-cache) on the same push went green in seconds.

The change adds the depspec-lint-form `runner` input to both workflows: default empty keeps the self-hosted farm label byte-for-byte (org callers unchanged), outside-org callers pass e.g. `runner: "[\"ubuntu-latest\"]"`.

## Claim binding (三问)

1. **Claims**: org-caller runner selection is unchanged (default resolves to the same labels); outside-org callers can now opt into hosted runners.
2. **Artifacts**: YAML parse + input presence asserted; `ci_trigger_policy.py` on the changed tree = 0 violations for this repo; targeted suites `test_job_timeouts` + `test_gate_ref_routing` (174 passed) and `test_weld_window` (23 passed) — the tests that pin these workflows' shapes — stay green.
3. **Enforcement**: `gate` — ci_trigger_policy and the named pytest suites re-run mechanically on this tree.
